text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the churn requirement was not actually checked.

- The comparison held up under the changes tested, but **“monthly churn < 4%”** could not be aligned with the model’s churn measure, so it played no part in the result.
- The comparison also assumes that higher MRR is the objective; that direction was not explicitly represented in the model.
- The result rests materially on Olumi estimates for the Pro subscriber base, new Pro sign-ups, monthly churn, and feature-release value—not recorded measurements.

The key reasoning gap is to define the churn measure in the same terms as the under-4% limit.
